source_caption_text:
Tee Grizzley took over a college campus as Rolling Loud brings its festival energy directly to students ahead of its upcoming movie 🔥🎬

The Detroit rapper surprised students with a high-energy performance as part of the Rolling Loud college tour, building excitement for Rolling Loud: The Movie, arriving in theaters October 2. The film stars Owen Wilson, Matt Rife, Christian Convery and Henry Winkler, with appearances from Travis Scott, Sexyy Red, Ty Dolla $ign and Ski Mask the Slump God.

From festival stages to college campuses and now the big screen, Rolling Loud continues to expand its impact on hip-hop culture 👀
